text.text_excerpt: I was so excited to visit Rosie's on the Roof at the Higgins Hotel. I've had the pleasure of visiting a couple of roof top bars around the city and I can confidently say Rosie's is in a league of its own. From the minute you step out of the the golden elevator your welcomed with a spacious bar/dinning area and a breath taking view. I choose to sit outside and omg like I said the view was gorgeous! The open sky, moonlight and city lights was the perfect background for a candle light dinner. The service was top notch and I felt very welcomed by the staff and Mark, who by the was such an amazing host !! Now I love a good cocktail and let me tell you when you go please get the skylark!! I have NO complaints about this place. The atmosphere was amazing. The view is phenomenal! We got: crab beignets, riveter fries, wings, and the club. Every thing was delicious. I also had the seasonal candy cane cocktail. It was like Christmas in a glass. The owner or manager (I'm not sure which), Marc, came talk to us. He was so friendly! We really enjoyed our conversation with us. He gave us so much great information about The Higgins and Rosie's. He also gave us some info on the WWII museum. I can't wait to go back!

This hotel looks great. I plan on doing a staycation here this year. I arrived a few minutes early for my reservation and was greeted by the bartender as I stepped of the elevator. I had the option of indoor or outdoor seating. It was a cold night but I wanted the view. Outside was my choice. While waiting Marc, Director of Sales, came over to talk. The conversation was both informative and exciting. There are so many updates planned for the WWII museum. When it is all done, the view from Rosie's on the Roof will be one of the best in the city.
